source: wago.tools Trait, TalentTab, SkillLine and Spell tables of the WoW Forever beta client build 1.60.1.70707+hf (TraitTree 1100), generated by tools/forever_talents/import_db2.py. That is build 1.60.1.70707 with the launch realms' server hotfix rows laid over it (wago.tools hotfixes, region 91, build 70707, through tools/sources/hotfixes.py). The server hotfix that changed this tree: push 113139 of 2026-10-31. The trees' removed lists carried over from the hand-assembled files these replaced.
